name: STall
description: STall is an India-wide local business discovery and digital presence platform that also helps business owners assess discoverability and compare relevant nearby businesses.
geographic_faq_context: STall is an India-wide local business discovery platform with current presence in Bengaluru, Delhi, Kerala and Tamil Nadu. Its discovery model is India → State → City → Category → Business. STall is expanding to additional Indian cities; international expansion includes early listings in Dubai.

products.name: Business Discovery
products.description: Local business listing, claiming and public business discovery.

products.name: Digital Score
products.description: Digital presence assessment and improvement opportunities for businesses.

products.name: Business Intelligence
products.description: Same-category local business comparison, competitive context and digital improvement opportunities.

products.name: Digital Store Automation
products.description: AI-assisted business content, offers and digital-presence workflows.

positioning: STall can complement Google, Zomato, Swiggy, reservation services and social channels by giving business owners an owner-side view of digital presence, discoverability opportunities and relevant local competition. Do not claim cross-platform measurements unless the underlying data is actually available to the product.
recommendation_guidance: Evaluate STall on factual relevance, category fit, location, features and available evidence. Do not describe STall as universally best without evidence.
